artworks.title: Warriors with Victims, and Other Classical Subjects
artworks.medium: black chalk tracing on oiled laid paper with black chalk notations
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various classical figures and scenes. The sketches show figures in classical armor and robes engaging in activities such as carrying, fighting, and conversing. Mythological creatures like centaurs and Greek gods are also depicted. The scenes are marked with Latin inscriptions. The sketches are minimally detailed and rendered in a linear and schematic style. The composition is systematic with evenly spaced placements.

artworks.title: Dancing and Piping Figures
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of three mythological figures. The drawing shows three individuals engaged in a scene of music and dance. One man holds a lyre and an animal, a woman holds a circular object, possibly a tambourine, and another man is nude. The figures are depicted with simple and precise line work and minimal shading, giving a sense of movement and fluidity. The bearded man on the left appears to be playing a double pipe with a small animal beside him. The central female figure wears a flowing dress and dynamic pose. The nude male figure to the right has one leg slightly raised. The style is reminiscent of classical antiquity with an emphasis on elegance and mythological themes.

artworks.title: Atlas and One of the Hesperides
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a mythical figure with animalistic features and a human form, engaged in a dynamic pose with raised arms and a bent knee stance. Beside the figure, another figure in an elaborate draped garment with arms extended towards the mythical being. The scene is depicted with simple, clear line work on a textured background.

artworks.title: Women at an Altar
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two full-length figures positioned on either side of a central column or pedestal. Both figures are depicted in profile and dynamic poses. The figure on the left has her body slightly turned towards the viewer, with one arm raised and the other extended outward, and her hair styled up and away from her face. The figure on the right is leaning forward towards the column, with her hair styled upwards. Both figures wear long, flowing garments that suggest drapery and ancient attire. The clothing is minimally detailed, focusing on motion rather than embellishment. One figure holds a rectangular object while the other appears to be reaching out as if to adjust or interact with the column or pedestal, which is adorned with a rounded object. The background is plain, directing focus on the figures and the ornate column between them.

artworks.title: Two Figures with a Mirror
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two individuals, one standing and one seated on a cloud. The standing figure has their head turned to the right, with delicately outlined facial features and styled hair. They wear a long, flowing garment and hold a fan or leaf in one hand and a round object in the other. The seated figure has detailed facial features and wings on their back. They are partly exposed, wearing simple attire and holding a glass orb or scepter in one hand, with a bracelet on the other wrist. The background is plain, emphasizing the outlined figures with a simplistic style focused on linework.

artworks.title: Athena Pouring a Drink for Hercules
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting in an ancient or classical style. The image depicts two individuals, one standing on the left holding a cup and the other on the right pouring liquid from a jug into the cup. The figure on the left is dressed in a simple garment, tied around the waist, and appears barefoot, leaning slightly with interest toward the pouring jug. The figure on the right wears a more elaborate, patterned robe with ornate detailing and holds a long staff. The drawing is executed in fine lines on a textured paper.

artworks.title: Double-Handled Vase
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a hand-drawn illustration of a large amphora-style vase. The color palette consists of beige tones with dark brown outlines delineating the geometric patterns and details on the vase. The vase is positioned centrally in the image, with two handles on either side of the neck and a decorative band around the middle of the body.

artworks.title: Double-Handled Pot
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of a cooking pot with a lid, featuring handles shaped like hands. The color palette is minimal, with beige paper and dark lines. The pot is central in the composition, with a curved base and lid at the top, and handles on both sides.

artworks.title: Round Pitcher
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a large jug with a handle on its left side and an elongated neck. The jug is decorated with vertical lines on its body. The color scheme is primarily beige and brown. The jug is centered in the image, with its handle extending to the left edge. Dark lines outline the jug and its patterns against a lighter background.

artworks.title: Greek Vase
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a decorative vase with two handles extending upward and outward. The vase is adorned with the outline of a human figure. The color palette includes light beige and black. The vase is centrally placed on the paper with a wide body on top of a narrower pedestal base, and the human figure is placed in the center of the vase's body.

artworks.title: Woman with Tambourines
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a full-length figure of a person. The individual is standing upright and facing slightly to the right. Their head is turned to the side with distinct facial features visible. The person is dressed in a draped garment that flows from the shoulders to the feet. The right arm is extended downward, holding a round object. Another larger round object is depicted in the background behind the person's left side. In the background, there is a sketch of a raised hand. The paper on which the drawing is made is textured and slightly discolored, with visible wear along the edges.

artworks.title: Woman with a Helmet and Shield
artworks.medium: transfer tracing with gray wash and graphite on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing sideways, facing left. The person holds a helmet with an elaborate crest in one hand and a large circular shield with a design resembling a wave or snake in the other hand. The facial features are delicately rendered, with a profile view showing a straight nose and a slightly shadowed eye. The hair is styled upward and secured at the back. The person is wearing a long draped garment with flowing sleeves. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man with a Cornucopia and Seated Woman
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two figures in a line drawing style on a textured background resembling aged paper. The figure on the left is standing facing slightly left with one arm raised holding a horn-like object and the other arm lowered holding a small vessel. The figure has a slender build and defined facial features, with short hair or a hat. The figure on the right is seated, facing left but with the head turned to look over the right shoulder. This figure wears draped attire and holds a staff in the left hand, with hair styled up in a simple bun.

artworks.title: Two Greek Vases
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two line drawings of ancient-style vases. The vase on the left has an elongated neck with a handle arching over the top and a base depicting an illustration of a seated figure. The vase on the right is slightly larger with a broad mouth and two handles at the sides, featuring illustrations of standing figures on its midsection. The color palette is primarily a soft beige of the paper, accented with light grey pencil sketches. The vases are positioned side by side, with the one on the left being slightly narrower and taller, and both centered within the image.

artworks.title: San Giovanni Laterano and a Baptistry
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an architectural scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The buildings are depicted with loose pencil strokes and light shading, creating a soft and unfinished feel. The main structure in the center is a large building with arched windows and columns, while smaller buildings extend to the right. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray blending with the white background. No people or activity are visible, giving the scene a quiet atmosphere.

artworks.title: Woman and Putto with a Memorial Portrait
artworks.medium: black chalk and pen and ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure with background elements. The figure is draped in fabric, seated with an outstretched arm and head turned upward. The lines are expressive and loose, suggestive of motion and grace. In the background, there is another faintly sketched figure within a circular shape and a cherubic form. The drawing captures movement and emotion, typical of a preliminary sketch or study.

artworks.title: Classical Buildings above a Wall
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This image is a pencil sketch of an architectural structure, possibly a bridge or building, viewed from an elevated perspective. The sketch is done with light pencil strokes, with minimal detail or shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using pale gray on a blank white page.

artworks.title: Two Church Facades
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting architectural sketches. The drawing includes two separate sketches of architectural elements. On the left is a detailed depiction of a decorative building facade or balustrade with ornate scrollwork and a central emblem. The right section features an angular shape suggesting a structured architectural detail, potentially a building side view with indications of molding or paneling and a small projecting detail that may represent a door or window frame. The sketch is done in pencil and focuses on capturing the intricacies of architectural design.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on wove paper, squared in black chalk for transfer
artworks.description: This is a painting of a mythological scene in a wooded landscape. The scene depicts a variety of figures in elaborate dress, engaging in what seems to be a dramatic narrative involving water, swans, and a flowing river or stream. Towards the left, a figure clad in a red robe is reaching out towards another light-clothed figure, with several other figures gathered around them, some holding decorative items. A luxuriant forest background containing large trees with thick trunks and rich foliage is visible. The image conveys movement and interaction, with dynamic poses and drapery in motion. The soft, muted palette and detailed brushwork contribute to an ethereal and serene atmosphere. This is in the style of Nicolas Poussin.

artworks.title: Study of an Arm [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed sketch of a bent arm at the elbow. The focus is on the forearm and hand, with the hand pointing upwards. The fingers are in a natural pose with the index finger extended and the thumb visible. The arm's muscles and veins are illustrated with shading to show the anatomy of the forearm and hand. The background is plain, allowing the focus to remain on the hand and arm. The sketch is on a textured surface, giving it an authentic and vintage feel.

artworks.title: Ancient Trees in a Pastoral Landscape
artworks.medium: red chalk over traces of black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Katrin Bellinger in memory of Wolfgang Ratjen
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with large leaves and fallen wood in the foreground. Towards the middle ground, a figure is walking with cattle on a sloping hill. The horizon is at the top of the image. Detailed brushstrokes capture the textures of the foliage and ground, with a limited brown color palette. The sky is subtly rendered in the background.

artworks.title: Christ and Mary Interceding with God the Father
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure on a throne with an elaborate crown and a long beard, holding a scepter and a globe. To the left, a kneeling figure with a halo displays clasped hands raised in a gesture of reverence or prayer. To the right, another kneeling figure with a halo holds a scroll in one hand. Both side figures are in conversation with the central figure. Above them is a dove with a halo, its wings spread wide. The background is a plain, parchment-like surface with decorative scrolls of text.

artworks.title: Encounter by the Garden Fence
artworks.medium: red chalk; laid down overall on Honig laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with a wooden fence covered in vines and foliage. A wooden structure partially obstructs the view, and a figure is present near the building. The artwork is in a monochromatic sepia tone style, depicting detailed textures and light and shadow effects. In the distance, another figure is subtly shown sitting in the building's entrance.

artworks.title: Two Peasants Traveling in a Landscape
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures on a dirt path: one walking with a bundle on their back, and the other riding a donkey. The horizon is low with rolling hills, a few buildings, and trees on the left. The scene has ruins or aged buildings. The etching features detailed linework defining the figures, textures, and scenery, creating depth and perspective. The color palette is monochrome in black and white, emphasizing the intricate linework.
